title: Crash in the editor when exceeding the maximum amount of reflection probes
body:
### Tested versions Reproducible in v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4], v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb], v4.8.dev.custom_build [3defa2466]. ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1074) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600H with Radeon Graphics (12 threads) - 15.34 GiB memory ### Issue description Godot crashes when the maximum amount (default is 64) of reflection probes is exceeded in the editor.
Log
